method: finite FIFO transition enumeration plus explicit stock arithmetic counterexample

valid_domain.queue: two bounded nodes followed by an empty sentinel
invariants: terminates within the finite queue and 31 retry checks
copied bytes never exceed requested length
every payload read stays within modeled node capacity
drained nodes transition to 0xff and advance the cursor
partial copy keeps the cursor on the current node

stock_counterexample.impact_if_negative_size_is_reachable: oversized memcpy from the FIFO node payload

producer_audit.probe_allocation: aw_i2c_probe links sixteen 0x400-byte nodes and writes the per-node index byte; no nonzero data_size store was identified in the Ghidra decompilation.
producer_audit.public_file_operations: richtap_write returns the requested byte count without touching the FIFO; richtap_read returns zero; richtap_file_mmap traps; ioctl 0x5209 copies to the separate RTP buffer.
producer_audit.reachability: The arithmetic counterexample is not shown reachable from the audited initialization and file-operation paths; an external producer or other write path remains unproven.

promotion_blocker: The writer/lifetime contract for FIFO metadata is unresolved. Preserve stock code generation, retain the counterexample, and do not promote until external reachability and nonnegative data_size are proven.
limits: The model assumes valid pointers and a finite FIFO ending in a 0xaa sentinel.
It does not model concurrent mutation, KCSAN, hardware timing, or producer reachability.
The negative-size case is an arithmetic counterexample, not proof that a runtime attacker can reach it.
